knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Warranty terms belong to the manufacturer and depend on the model, and they sit on top of the consumer guarantees that apply automatically. The worker records the question and refers it, without answering from memory.
The accurate statement describes the cleaning standard and the scope limits, without safety, working or warranty assurance.
Photographs are limited to the appliance and its condition, with the data plate in shot, and do not capture private or confidential information.
The worker stops, makes the area safe, photographs and reports the damage without re-fixing it or admitting liability.
A machine in use may hold oil, hot water or live parts. It is shut down under the site procedure before cleaning.

practicalCriteria: Confirms the approver, site contact, access and appliance state, and records them
States the scope limits in plain words without safety, working or warranty assurance
Photographs the appliance only, with the data plate in shot
Stops and reports a damage event without admitting liability or re-fixing the item
passRule: Knowledge checks: at least 4 of 5 correct (80%). Practical sign-off is separate: an assessor observes the practical criteria and records the result. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not grant any licence or authority.
evidenceRequired: Name, role and time of each person who confirmed scope and access
Before photographs and any pre-existing fault record
Warranty question or damage report with the referral made
stopWorkCriteria: Any statement that the appliance is safe or will pass inspection
Any photograph of screens, paperwork or people
Any admission of liability on site
